project: Claude Code Bot - v2 Streaming & Conversations
description: Add multi-conversation support with SDK session resume, real-time streaming output, and agent-driven conversation management via custom MCP tools

userStories.title: Replace memory.py with ConversationStore
userStories.description: Replace the old per-user message storage with a ConversationStore that tracks conversation metadata. Each user can have multiple named conversations, each with a session_id for SDK resume.
acceptanceCriteria: ConversationMeta model with fields: conversation_id (uuid4), user_id, name, session_id (optional), created_at (float), last_active (float)
ConversationStore class with methods: list(user_id), get(user_id, conv_id), create(user_id, name?), update(meta), delete(user_id, conv_id)
Storage in data/conversations/{safe_user_id}.json as JSON array of ConversationMeta
safe_user_id sanitizes / and .. to _
create() auto-generates name 'Conversation N' if name not provided
Directory auto-created if missing
Old Message/MemoryBackend/JsonFileMemoryBackend classes removed
Typecheck passes

verificationCommands.command: uv run python -c "from claude_code_bot.memory import ConversationStore, ConversationMeta; print('ok')"

userStories.notes: Write tests: create, list, get, update, delete, auto-name, missing dir, safe id, persistence

userStories.title: Create conversation management MCP tools
userStories.description: Create custom MCP tools using the SDK @tool decorator that let the agent manage conversations through natural language. The agent can list, create, switch, and delete conversations when the user asks.
acceptanceCriteria: New file src/claude_code_bot/tools.py
Uses @tool decorator and create_sdk_mcp_server() from claude_agent_sdk
Tool: list_conversations - returns list of user's conversations with id, name, last_active
Tool: create_conversation - takes optional name, creates new conversation, returns metadata
Tool: switch_conversation - takes conversation_id, returns confirmation with conversation name
Tool: delete_conversation - takes conversation_id, deletes it, returns confirmation
Function create_conversation_tools(store, user_id) returns McpSdkServerConfig
Each tool accesses ConversationStore via closure
Typecheck passes

verificationCommands.command: uv run python -c "from claude_code_bot.tools import create_conversation_tools; print('ok')"

userStories.notes: Test each tool handler directly (unit test the async functions). The tools receive args dict and return MCP content format.

userStories.title: Rewrite AgentService with streaming and session resume
userStories.description: Rewrite agent.py to use SDK session resume for conversation continuity and include_partial_messages for real-time streaming. Add chat_stream() method that yields normalized events.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentService.__init__ takes config, ConversationStore, and SubAgentRegistry
chat_stream(user_id, message, conversation_id?) is an async generator yielding event dicts

Event types: {type: 'text', content: str}, {type: 'tool_start', tool: str}, {type: 'tool_done', tool: str}, {type: 'result', content: str, session_id: str}, {type: 'error', content: str}, {type: 'conversation_switched', conversation_id: str}
ClaudeAgentOptions uses include_partial_messages=True
If ConversationMeta.session_id exists, passes resume=session_id to ClaudeAgentOptions
Captures session_id from SystemMessage with subtype=='init' via message.data.get('session_id')
Persists session_id and last_active to ConversationMeta after each interaction
If conversation_id is None, uses most recent conversation or auto-creates one
Conversation MCP tools registered via mcp_servers option with allowed_tools including mcp__conversations__* tools
System prompt includes instruction that agent can manage conversations when user asks
Retry with exponential backoff on failure (3 attempts)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Mock claude_agent_sdk.query to yield fake SystemMessage(init) + StreamEvent + AssistantMessage + ResultMessage. Test session_id capture, streaming events, conversation auto-create, resume option passing.

userStories.title: Add SSE streaming endpoint and conversation REST API
userStories.description: Add POST /chat/stream SSE endpoint that streams events from chat_stream(), and REST endpoints for conversation CRUD.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /chat/stream accepts {user_id, message, conversation_id?} and returns text/event-stream
SSE events formatted as: data: {json}\n\n for each event from chat_stream()
GET /conversations/{user_id} returns list of ConversationResponse objects
POST /conversations/{user_id} with optional {name} body creates conversation
DELETE /conversations/{user_id}/{conversation_id} deletes conversation
ConversationResponse model: conversation_id, name, created_at, last_active
Old POST /chat endpoint removed
GET /health still works
Lifespan initializes ConversationStore and passes to AgentService
Typecheck passes

verificationCommands.command: uv run pytest tests/ -k 'chat or conversation' -v

userStories.notes: Test SSE endpoint with httpx streaming. Test conversation CRUD endpoints. Mock AgentService.chat_stream to yield test events.

userStories.title: Update CLI agent.py with streaming display
userStories.description: Update the CLI tool to use the SSE endpoint and display streamed tokens, tool indicators, and subagent activity in real-time.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI uses POST /chat/stream SSE endpoint
Text tokens printed as they arrive (no buffering)
Tool use shown as: [Using ToolName...] done
Subagent activity shown when parent_tool_use_id present
Final result clearly delineated
--conversation ID flag to target specific conversation
--debug flag shows raw SSE events
Interactive mode (-i) works with streaming
No special /list or /new commands — user asks agent naturally
userStories.notes: Use httpx streaming response to read SSE. Parse 'data: ' lines as JSON events.
